lens: CSS architect (cascade layers, dead-code removal, pixel-diff discipline)
reads: research/cedar-springs-teardown-blueprint.md (moved from the repo root at the seed commit)
deliverables: w3 (parallel with families): tools/check-css.mjs — no 50-legacy-* files, no duplicate selectors across files, every animation/transition routed through the motion policy custom properties, prefers-reduced-motion only in tokens.css/95-motion.css, layer declared in every file
w3b (exclusive lock after the family merges): delete leftover legacy slices, dedupe, consolidate
acceptance: ≤ 0.1 % pixel diff across the screenshot matrix before/after w3b
CSS gz per page ≤ 28 KB warn / 36 KB fail
gates: cd $WT/site && node tools/dev-setup.mjs --devtools   # once it exists (W1 build); before that: tsc --typeRoots /opt/node-tools/node_modules/@types
node build.mjs --offline-images --out=$OUT && SITE_DIST=$OUT node tools/check-all.mjs --no-build [--strict-redirects from W1 ia on]
PORT=$PORT SITE_DIST=$OUT node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --trace off
node tools/a11y.mjs --themes=dark,light --widths=320,1440 --motion=off,on   # once qa lands; until then axe via the global helper
verifierLens: Cascade forensics: per-selector diff of computed styles across the screenshot matrix
portRule: builder = port; reviewer = port + 10; fixer = port + 20; evidence collector 4400
returns: {branch, head, base, files, gates, acceptance[], requests[]}
requests: .orchestra/requests/css-consolidator.md (never edit a file outside owns; describe the change there)
